decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s existing fabricated solutions for utility and industrial customers, it is a low-cost option to keep open because one year on the market reveals too little to justify abandonment.

Public waste bins are more distant from the core offer, so the risk of later withdrawal is higher, but the product still uses the firm’s metalworking, coating, and public-sector sales capabilities and is worth keeping while demand uncertainty resolves.
Ground sleeves fit the firm’s fabrication skills and infrastructure-related customer base, so management would likely continue this nearby option given limited evidence and modest holding costs.

Cast iron ground sleeves appear somewhat less natural than the firm’s steel-processing core, but they remain close enough to existing capabilities and markets to justify keeping the option open for another year.
Steel ground sleeves are strongly aligned with the firm’s established materials expertise and market direction, so there is little reason to drop them before more market feedback arrives.
